caseName: Evans v. U.S. Dist. Court for the S. Dist. of Ohio
caseNameFull: William H. EVANS, Jr. v. UNITED STATES DISTRICT COURT FOR the SOUTHERN DISTRICT OF OHIO.

opinions.text: Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis denied, and petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Sixth Circuit dismissed. See Rule 39.8.
